first_failure.message: Bound Windows completion: invalid heartbeat phase

cause: The bound loop observed proc.poll()==None, consumed trusted terminal success, then sent/flushed a due PING. The new _WindowsCompletion.control rejects heartbeat after terminal. This is the first recorded validation failure, not a captured Win32 API failure.
secondary_failure: Cleanup sent/flushed CANCEL; the success-only facts validator rejected cancellation/control. This secondary error does not replace the PING failure.
checks: All13 frozen source pins and interpreter/admission/review/expected-user hashes match actual attempt and current sources.

Actual same-shell name/SID match expected and earlier accepted context; admin role disabled, SYSTEM/anonymous false, no RunAs, require_escalated value recorded. Supported mode additionally relies on parent tool transcript.

Submitted synthetic bytes/input-contract, complete original context, separate control nonce, exact command/stage/deadline and current native membership/image/creation identity match actual saved request, launch and readiness.
Exact labelled synthetic output exists. Trusted bootstrap protocol reports child.wait exit0 without child cancellation/force, then natural succeeded terminal.

Sticky post-terminal PING failure prevented issuance; coordinator stopped on authority=None. Copied/replayed native probes and acceptance were not reached; no conditioning/shape completion receipt exists.
Final stage and outer Jobs are empty without forced cleanup. Runner remains failed/natural=false, returncode=null, with bootstrap_returncode absent because assignment was never reached.
269 health records meet RAM/disk floors; OS peaks and25s/90s bounds hold. Retained259/live samples can be stale and do not establish surviving processes.
70 distinct focused CPU tests include37 independently repeated mocks; overlap is not added as new coverage. Reviewer reran no tests or native execution.

limits: Sole recorded native attempt is BLOCKED. No code correction, retry, alternate native run or further execution occurred.
No completion authority was issued or accepted natively. One-use/copy/replay proof remains CPU-only.
Trusted host interpreter and ordinary private IPC are assumed; no general hostile same-user-process isolation claim.
Native evidence is one synthetic conditioning worker, not semantic/model/checkpoint closure, complete upstream job, WSL, GPU or Generate.
Final Job accounting proves emptiness; no all-process exit0, unsaved parent graph or zero-byte allocator release is inferred.
The preservation receipts no-execution flag describes only the read-only preservation checker. The overall mission separately recorded exactly one native attempt, which was BLOCKED.
